intermediate.title: Red Bull KM Sprint | Ostuni (84.2 km)

story: In the first stage held on Italian soil, Francisco Muñoz tried a lone early escape, but he was caught with over 50 kilometres remaining. Pink jersey wearer Pedersen was delayed by a crash and had to be brought back to the peloton. The stage ended in a mass sprint, won by Casper van Uden, completing an all-Dutch podium.
